judge_comment: FAIL ['C3']: The assessment lists "KYC is complete and audited accounts have been provided" as a mitigant, which is explicitly a non-genuine pass/fail entry requirement with no margin to measure (R8), failing C3. All other criteria pass: no rule has FAIL/UNABLE_TO_VERIFY status (C1), all figures and terms are grounded in the extracted data (C2), the guarantee is accurately described as limited to £300,000 (C4, C5), and the other mitigants (LTV 64.9% vs 75%, DSCR 1.65x vs 1.25x, net debt/EBITDA 1.9x vs 3.5x, covenants stricter than policy) are genuine.

FAIL ['C2', 'C5']: The assessment lists "Six years of trading history exceeds the minimum two-year requirement and demonstrates operating experience" as a mitigant, but R10 (FAIL) shows the registry check found the stated 6.0 years of trading exceeds the 1.5 years since incorporation by more than a year — i.e., the trading history is contradicted by the registry and cannot be cited as a mitigant (C5), and stating it as fact is unsupported by the rule results (C2).
